body.head: ABRAHAM LINCOLN

div.head: Quotes and Images from the Writings of Abraham Lincoln
div.p: Included here are quotations and references to subjects in the eight volumes of "The Writings of Abraham Lincoln". It begins with his first political address in 1832 and ends with a hastily scrawled note on the day of his assassination. It is hoped that the design of the page with quotations scrolling down along the side of various steel engravings and photographs of this great man might give the words a greater impact. D. W.
